Name: Animal Chooser
Author: stokastic
Description:
[size=4]NOTEABLE FEATURES:[/size]
[list]
[*]Allows selection of chicken and cow colour during purchase
[*]Allows setting animal's heart level during purchase
[*]Allows spawning animals as adults (skip baby stage)
[/list]
[size=4]INSTALL[/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of SMAPI
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into[code] ﻿Stardew Valley/﻿Mods﻿.[/code]
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=4]USAGE[/size]
[list]
[*]From Marnie's shop, select the animal you wish to purchase. While choosing a building, change the animal color with the left and right arrow keys
[*]Similarly, the animal's heart level can be changed by scrolling the mouse wheel up and down
[*]The config file has an option to force new animals to spawn as adults (off by default)
[*]Blue and Void chickens must be unlocked in game first, or force-enabled in the config file
[/list]
[size=4]COMPATIBILITY[/size]
[list]
[*][size=2]Works with SMAPI 2.7 and SDV 1.3.28 on Windows (Other OS not tested)[/size]

[/list]
[size=4]SEE ALSO[/size][list]
[*][url=https://github.com/stokastic/AnimalChooser]Code[/url]﻿
[/list]
